command: [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); $prepOperatingSystem=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $prepPower=Get-CimInstance -Namespace root/cimv2/power -ClassName Win32_PowerPlan | Where-Object IsActive; $prepProcesses=Get-Process | Group-Object ProcessName | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{name=$_.Name;count=$_.Count;workingSetBytes=[long](($_.Group | Measure-Object WorkingSet64 -Sum).Sum)}}; [ordered]@{windows=[ordered]@{caption=$prepOperatingSystem.Caption;version=$prepOperatingSystem.Version;build=$prepOperatingSystem.BuildNumber;architecture=$prepOperatingSystem.OSArchitecture;freePhysicalMemoryKiB=[long]$prepOperatingSystem.FreePhysicalMemory}; power=@($prepPower | Select-Object ElementName,InstanceID);backgroundProcesses=@($prepProcesses | Sort-Object name)} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress
